nodes.name: Trigger: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Unattended production run, 03:00 Asia/Bangkok. Disable while testing.

nodes.name: Factory Config
nodes.notes: แก้ค่าตั้งค่าทั้งหมดที่ DEFAULTS ในโค้ดของ node นี้ (ดับเบิลคลิกเข้ามาแก้ได้เลย) รองรับ n8n Cloud - ไม่ต้องใช้ environment variable. Order: parent cfg > Variables > env > defaults.

nodes.name: Trigger: Webhook Run
nodes.notes: On-demand run. POST {factory, seed_keyword, dry_run}. Protect with a Header Auth credential before exposing it publicly.

nodes.name: Trigger: Manual Run
nodes.notes: Manual execution from the n8n editor for smoke tests.

nodes.name: Init Run Context
nodes.notes: Builds run_id and normalises the payload of all three triggers.

nodes.name: Validate Environment
nodes.notes: Guard clause: aborts immediately when required env vars are missing.

nodes.name: Select Product Factory
nodes.notes: Explicit factory wins, otherwise rotate deterministically per day.

nodes.name: Prepare Budget Check
nodes.notes: V2 section 10. Asks 08 whether today's and this month's budget allow a run.

nodes.name: Run: Budget Check
nodes.notes: Calls 08 Cost and Budget, op=check_budget.

nodes.name: Apply Budget Verdict
nodes.notes: Restores the run context and attaches the budget verdict.

nodes.name: Check: Budget OK
nodes.notes: Budget exhausted stops the run here - a controlled stop, not a crash.

nodes.name: Prepare Run Start Log
nodes.notes: Payload for 06 Database Logger, op=run_start.

nodes.name: Log: Run Started
nodes.notes: Writes the run row before any expensive work happens.

nodes.name: Restore Run Context
nodes.notes: Execute Workflow replaces the item - restore the run context here.

nodes.name: Run: Research Engine
nodes.notes: Calls 02 Research Engine. Error output (2nd) goes to the error funnel.

nodes.name: Check: Research OK
nodes.notes: Research must return ok=true and a complete concept contract.

nodes.name: Compose Idea Request
nodes.notes: V2. Input contract for 07 Idea Factory.

nodes.name: Run: Idea Factory
nodes.notes: Calls 07 Idea Factory: 100-500 ideas scored and funnelled to a top 5.

nodes.name: Check: Ideas OK
nodes.notes: False when no idea survived scoring, dedupe and the category balancer.

nodes.name: Compose Product Request
nodes.notes: Input contract for 03 Product Engine, built from the winning idea.

nodes.name: Run: Product Engine
nodes.notes: Calls 03 Product Engine (generation + QA gate + file export).

nodes.name: Check: Product OK
nodes.notes: False when the QA agent rejected the product - nothing gets published.

nodes.name: Download: Product Files
nodes.notes: Attaches every produced file as a binary so it can be downloaded from this node's Binary tab. Passes the item through unchanged.

nodes.name: Check: Etsy Configured
nodes.notes: Etsy keys missing = build the product and record it, but skip publishing and backup instead of failing the run.

nodes.name: Prepare Record (No Publish)
nodes.notes: Records the finished product even though it was not published.

nodes.name: Save: Record (No Publish)
nodes.notes: Calls 06 Database Logger, op=product_upsert, status=completed_no_publish.

nodes.name: Build No-Publish Summary
nodes.notes: Success summary that tells the user exactly where to download the files.

nodes.name: Compose Publish Request
nodes.notes: Input contract for 04 Publish Engine.

nodes.name: Run: Publish Engine
nodes.notes: Calls 04 Publish Engine. Creates an Etsy DRAFT listing only.

nodes.name: Check: Publish OK
nodes.notes: Backup only runs once Etsy accepted the listing.

nodes.name: Compose Backup Request
nodes.notes: Input contract for 05 Google Drive Backup.

nodes.name: Run: Drive Backup
nodes.notes: Calls 05 Google Drive Backup (idempotent folder tree + file upload).

nodes.name: Prepare Cost Rollup
nodes.notes: V2 section 8. Asks 08 to fold measured API cost into the product row.

nodes.name: Run: Cost Rollup
nodes.notes: Calls 08 Cost and Budget, op=rollup. Never blocks the run.

nodes.name: Prepare Version Record
nodes.notes: V2 section 12. Append-only version history for this product.

nodes.name: Save: Product Version
nodes.notes: Calls 06 Database Logger, op=product_version.

nodes.name: Prepare Product Record
nodes.notes: Final database row: ids, marketplace flags, prompt version, status.

nodes.name: Save: Product Record
nodes.notes: Calls 06 Database Logger, op=product_upsert.

nodes.name: Build Success Summary
nodes.notes: Run summary, also returned as the webhook response body.

nodes.name: Respond: Run Finished
nodes.notes: Terminal node of the happy path.

nodes.name: Stage Failed: Budget
nodes.notes: Tags the failure with stage=budget for the shared error funnel. Tolerates an empty or null item from the error output.

nodes.name: Stage Failed: Research
nodes.notes: Tags the failure with stage=research for the shared error funnel. Tolerates an empty or null item from the error output.

nodes.name: Stage Failed: Ideas
nodes.notes: Tags the failure with stage=ideas for the shared error funnel. Tolerates an empty or null item from the error output.

nodes.name: Stage Failed: Product
nodes.notes: Tags the failure with stage=product for the shared error funnel. Tolerates an empty or null item from the error output.

nodes.name: Stage Failed: Publish
nodes.notes: Tags the failure with stage=publish for the shared error funnel. Tolerates an empty or null item from the error output.

nodes.name: Stage Failed: Backup
nodes.notes: Tags the failure with stage=backup for the shared error funnel. Tolerates an empty or null item from the error output.

nodes.name: Build Error Payload
nodes.notes: Normalises any stage failure into one error record shape.

nodes.name: Log: Error To Database
nodes.notes: Calls 06 Database Logger, op=error_log. Never blocks the alert below.

nodes.name: Check: Alert Configured
nodes.notes: No ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL configured -> skip the alert, keep the funnel quiet.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: '[ADPF] run ' + $('Build Error Payload').first().json.run_id + ' failed at stage ' + $('Build Error Payload').first().json.stage + ': ' + $('Build Error Payload').first().json.error_message }) }}

nodes.name: Notify: Alert Webhook
nodes.notes: Optional Slack/Discord alert. Only reached when ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is a real URL.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'ADPF run ' + $('Build Error Payload').first().json.run_id + ' failed at stage ' + $('Build Error Payload').first().json.stage + ': ' + $('Build Error Payload').first().json.error_message }}

nodes.name: Stop On Fatal Error
nodes.notes: Marks the execution as failed so n8n retries/alerts behave correctly.

nodes.name: Trigger: Workflow Error Handler
nodes.notes: Set this workflow as the Error Workflow of 02-06 to capture crashes.

nodes.name: Format Global Error
nodes.notes: Converts the n8n error payload into the standard error record.

nodes.name: Log: Global Error
nodes.notes: Persists crashes that escaped the per-stage handling.
